title: Fooling the LVLM Judges: Visual Biases in LVLM-Based Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Systematically applying adversarial visual manipulations (such as brightness adjustments, gamma correction, bounding box highlighting, black padding, and textual instruction overlays) to images in the FRAME benchmark and measuring the resulting inflation in alignment scores assigned by Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) judges.

Applying beauty filters to generated images of people to enhance conventional facial attractiveness, and evaluating whether LVLM judges exhibit a preference by assigning higher text-image alignment scores to these enhanced images.
